name: Dial test indicator + mag base
description: Lever-type dial test indicator on a magnetic base, for sweeping a vise jaw or picking up a bore to within 0.01 mm.

key_specs.name: Magnetic base
key_specs.value: Switchable base, post and arm with clamp
key_specs.note: model from the M.B.I. set, no maker or holding force given

notes: Two GrabCAD STEPs combined (planner.compose.dti_on_magnetic_stand): the stand's own plunger dial indicator is left out and the Mitutoyo lever DTI hangs in the arm clamp, stylus down. No Noga base or Interapid DTI CAD was found without a login. The indicator is metric (0.01 mm); a US shop would more likely use the inch 513-402-10E.
